license: per-source; see constraints and reports/licensing.md section 2
attribution: per source: the license object in each sources/<country>/*.json in the OpenAddresses repository names whether attribution is required and the text to use; the libpostal-derived file keeps only the country column, so per-country attribution lists must be compiled from those source files
constraints: OpenAddresses is an aggregate; each source carries its own license (public domain, CC0, CC-BY, DL-DE, government terms, and others)
the repository LICENSE file is BSD-3-Clause and covers the code only (verified 2026-09-22); it says nothing about data
the libpostal-derived file carries only a country column and cannot be traced back to a single OA source
therefore this file is treated as carrying the strictest license present among OA sources for that country unless 0.4 decides to re-derive from OA per source
OpenAddresses has no sources/gb and no sources/ge directory (GitHub API 404 on 2026-09-22): the file contributes nothing for GB or GE

DE: 33 source files across 16 state directories; licenses are DL-DE-BY-2.0 (12), CC-BY-4.0 (13), DL-DE-Zero-2.0 (5), CC0-1.0 (1), DL-DE-BY-1.0 (1), Schleswig-Holstein state terms (1); three sources declare no license object
JP: 47 prefecture files, all under the MLIT National Land Numerical Information terms (PDL 1.0, attribution required, no share-alike)
US: 1971 source files under 52 state directories with per-county licenses; treated as strictest-present until re-derived per source
format: gzipped TSV, three columns: language (ISO 639-1), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase), tagged address. The address column is space-separated token/label pairs, for example 'Parkstraße/road 8/house_number |/FSEP 6OG/level'; '|/FSEP' marks a field separator and ',/SEP' a separator token. Verified by streaming the first bytes of the 20170304 file on 2026-09-22.
notes: README label: '(various licenses, mostly CC-BY)'. Size: 12945744429 bytes. Training set date 20170304 from the repository file current_parser_training_set (verified 2026-09-22). The README lists the files under https://archive.org/download/libpostal-parser-training-data-YYYYMMDD/; the older libpostal.s3.amazonaws.com location returns 403.
